source.edition: Advaita Śāradā, Sringeri, Pancharatna Stotrāṇi, text 5
source.digitalText: Traditional Sanskrit text; original English translation and word-for-word gloss

units.label: Verse 1
units.deva:
वेदो नित्यमधीयतां तदुदितं कर्म स्वनुष्ठीयतां
तेनेशस्य विधीयतामपचितिः काम्ये मतिस्त्यज्यताम् ।
पापौघः परिधूयतां भवसुखे दोषोऽनुसन्धीयताम्
आत्मेच्छा व्यवसीयतां निजगृहात्तूर्णं विनिर्गम्यताम् ॥
units.translation: Study the Veda daily; carefully perform the duties it teaches; through them render worship to the Lord; give up desire for results; wash away the mass of wrongdoing; reflect on the fault in worldly pleasure; resolve upon the longing for the Self; leave home at once.

units.label: Verse 2
units.deva:
सङ्गः सत्सु विधीयतां भगवतो भक्तिर्दृढाधीयतां
शान्त्यादिः परिचीयतां दृढतरं कर्माशु संत्यज्यताम् ।
सद्विद्वानुपसर्प्यतां प्रतिदिनं तत्पादुका सेव्यतां
ब्रह्मैकाक्षरमर्थ्यतां श्रुतिशिरोवाक्यं समाकर्ण्यताम् ॥
units.translation: Keep company with the good; establish firm devotion to the Lord; cultivate peace and the other virtues; quickly give up action that binds; approach a knower of truth; serve the teacher’s sandals each day; seek the single syllable Brahman; listen closely to the teaching at the crown of the Veda.

gloss.en: with the good, among the wise
let it be sought, prayed for
the word at the crown of the Veda
let it be listened to attentively

units.label: Verse 3
units.deva:
वाक्यार्थः सुविचार्यतां श्रुतिशिरःपक्षः समाश्रीयतां
दुस्तर्कात्सुविरम्यतां श्रुतिमतस्तर्कोऽनुसन्धीयताम् ।
ब्रह्मास्मीति विभाव्यतामहरहर्गर्वः परित्यज्यतां
देहेऽहम्मतिरुज्झ्यतां बुधजनैर्वादः परित्यज्यताम् ॥
units.translation: Examine the meaning of the teaching with care; take refuge in the purport of the Upaniṣads; withdraw from false reasoning and follow reasoning grounded in revelation; contemplate “I am Brahman” day after day; abandon pride; cast off the thought “I am the body”; and give up disputation with the wise.

gloss.en: the crown of the Veda, the Upaniṣads
let it be taken as refuge

units.label: Verse 4
units.deva:
क्षुद्व्याधिश्च चिकित्स्यतां प्रतिदिनं भिक्षौषधं भुज्यतां
स्वाद्वन्नं न तु याच्यतां विधिवशात्प्राप्तेन संतुष्यताम् ।
औदासीन्यमभीप्स्यतां जनकृपानैष्ठुर्यमुत्सृज्यतां
शीतोष्णादि विषह्यतां न तु वृथा वाक्यं समुच्चार्यताम् ॥
units.translation: Treat hunger, the body’s affliction; take alms each day as medicine; do not ask for tasty food; be content with what comes by providence; seek equanimity; give up dependence on people’s kindness and harshness toward them; endure heat, cold, and the like; do not utter words in vain.

units.label: Verse 5
units.deva:
एकान्ते सुखमास्यतां परतरे चेतः समाधीयतां
पूर्णात्मा सुसमीक्ष्यतां जगदिदं तद्बाधितं दृश्यताम् ।
प्राक्कर्म प्रविलाप्यतां चितिबलान्नाप्युत्तरैः श्लिष्यतां
प्रारब्धं त्विह भुज्यतामथ परब्रह्मात्मना स्थीयताम् ॥
units.translation: Dwell happily in solitude; settle the mind in the supreme; clearly behold the complete Self; see this world as sublated by That; dissolve prior karma; do not become bound by future karma through the strength of awareness; undergo the karma already begun; then abide as the supreme Brahman.
